thread:
maya: Quick kickoff — coordinating with Datadog + StrategicIntegrations (SI) on the telemetry bundle for the marketplace tile. Goal: ship a plug-and-play OTLP pipeline + prebuilt dashboards, and an air-gapped collector option for on-prem customers. Timeline: target marketplace submission week of Apr 18.

eva-dd: Thanks Maya — Datadog side ready to own dashboard templates and validation for the tile. Can we lock an embargo window? We need final assets 3 business days before submission for legal/marketing checks.

harry-si: Air-gap variant question — do we expect customers to run a local collector or use our SI-managed appliance? Need clarity so we size the runbook.

alex: Two engineering q's: (1) how big are the prebuilt dashboard JSONs (we might want to host them separately), (2) is the expectation to include a Helm chart + k8s manifests in the bundle?

josh: Marketplace packaging note — GCP/AWS marketplaces want a self-contained artifact (docs + manifests + test report). We'll need a short install script and a static README. Also prefer a screenshot + 30s demo video for listing. :movie_camera:

dd-integration-bot: Integration smoke: OTLP ingest validation passed on staging (build-2026.04.05). Link: https://ci.example/otlp-smoke/2345 :white_check_mark:

sam: Quick config sample for the collector we discussed (OTLP over TLS + reduced telemetry for cost-sensitive users):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp: {}
processors:
  batch: {}
  resourcedetection: {}
exporters:
  otlp/dogfood:
    endpoint: "https://otlp.datadog.example:4317"
    tls:
      insecure: false
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch, resourcedetection]
      exporters: [otlp/dogfood]
```
Notes: default sampling placed in front if customer wants head-sampling; we should include a sample_rate env var in the Helm values.

eva-dd: That config looks good. Metric/tag naming: please include `redwood.cluster` and `redwood.gateway` as default resource labels. We'll run a small mapping step on our side so dashboards render out-of-the-box.

harry-si: For the air-gapped distro, SI will need: (1) a packaged tarball with collector binary + config, (2) a small script to load dashboards from local JSON files, (3) an install checklist for offline cert generation. Can eng produce those artifacts?

alex: Yup — we can produce a tar.gz containing the collector binary, `dashboards/` JSON, and `install-offline.sh`. For k8s customers we'll add an offline mode to the Helm chart. I'll draft the script and push a skeleton by EOD tomorrow.

josh: Action items (owners):
- alex: offline install artifact + Helm offline overlay (due Apr 10)
- eva-dd: dashboard JSONs + mapping rules (due Apr 12)
- harry-si: SI runbook + appliance checklist (due Apr 14)
- sam: collector config variants + sampling guide (due Apr 11)
- maya: submission coordination + embargo management (due Apr 15)
Can ppl confirm?

eva-dd: Confirmed. I'll also record a 5-minute smoke demo and upload to the shared drive by Apr 13.

harry-si: Confirmed on SI runbook, will include runbook steps, offline cert commands, and validation scripts.

sam: Confirmed. I'll add `values.sampleRate` to the chart and a small FAQ about token throttling.

alex: Confirmed — pushing skeleton in a PR later today (link will follow).

maya: Great — last thing: marketing/PR embargo. We agreed no external mention before Apr 19. Josh, can you coordinate with legal once all assets are in? :lock:

josh: Will do. Please @me in the final checklist thread. Also need a short one-pager with benefits (cost, latency, observability parity) for the marketplace tile blurb.

eva-dd: I'll work with marketing on the blurb draft after dashboards are finalized.

maya: Thanks everyone — I'll compile the tracker and ping this thread with a single checklist doc. :rocket:
